notes: Exactly six source-owner/menu/Settings scenes, with twelve region-derived edges F5-PEO-01 through F5-PEO-12. No coordinator, ordinary thread, phone or app chrome scene is owned here. Parent owns F5-P-COORDINATOR and native menu entry controls. All frame bodies use x340..1580/y108..876 in the 1600x1040, app-height-900 contract. Plain text uses style:none; typography is Inter 14/12 with 18px section titles, and action buttons are 32px high.

All content is explicitly a read-only design fixture. No renderer, check, build, test, lint, formatter, Figma/browser/desktop/app action, repository/Git/provider/CI/secret action or external service operation was performed. These scenes establish static design data only, not runtime behavior, measured text fit, accessibility or native/mobile parity.

Source identities and visible row titles come from base.json and collections.json: GitHub acme/factory#237 rev3 Open; #231 rev2 Open; #229 rev1 Open; brief-14 rev2 Draft; brief-15 rev1 Draft; research-7 rev1 Sealed; rss-engineering/item-8 rev1 Reviewed. Fixture owners match collection labels: Mara, Ilan and Unassigned. Brief, protocol and RSS detail prose is supplementary fictional fixture text, not fetched source content or research findings.

The source previews carry SourceRefs only. They do not instantiate or reset PlanItemRefs, retained WorkRefs, claims, invocation records or native threads. Parent preserves the entire caller snapshot, including collection view, query, selected owner-qualified identity and pre/post-admission associations. #237 source detail does not assume whether plan-237 exists in its caller. Reading a source cannot undo planning or dispatch.

Inbound collection links: F5-CE63 and F5-CE66 open Issues from F5-C00 and F5-C01; F5-CE64 and F5-CE67 open Briefs; F5-CE65 and F5-CE68 open Research. F5-PEO-08/09/10 are type:back, effect:return with allowedOrigins C00/C01/More. Sources F5-PEO-11 and Settings F5-PEO-12 return only to More. No source page uses NavigateTo More, and each page has exactly one native Back control. The to:More value is a fallback for a missing origin, never a fixed destination overriding a captured C00/C01 origin.

More contains six actual navigation links: Issues, Briefs, Sources, Research, parent-owned Coordinator and Scheduled tasks in Settings. F5-PEO-07 Close is the only menu return. Its allowedOrigins enumerate existing collection/workflow workspace pages where the parent native header may open the menu. W07 accepted dispatch and W08 thread are excluded from the generic menu-close origins; no return crosses a mutation or dispatch. Parent captures read-only menu nesting after the current state is committed; Close restores that exact current state, not a prior actionable snapshot. C00 is only a missing-origin fallback.

All shell.navTargets are empty. The parent draws common native project tabs and supplies context-safe menu and Workflows navigation. No fixed Work tab is authored here, and no context-specific workflow return or initialization state is patched by this slice. New workflow management belongs Workflows; Scheduled tasks remains the existing native project-associated prompt scheduler, not a second workflow engine.

Issues remain own-repository forge records, Briefs human-authored revisioned input, Research a separately sealed protocol, and Sources checkout-bound RSS/Atom. Sources and Research are desktop-only reviews with no mobile authoring claim. A source status never substitutes for a project planning stage, provider progress, acceptance or delivery.

Existing Admit and start in Sources is preserved literally as a disabled static control without any edge. It is an execution launch creating an isolated-worktree task; the visible no-launch study boundary makes it unavailable. No Add to plan replacement, extra source action or planner/claim state is added.

Settings task names, prompt snippets, times, statuses, filter and receipt text are fictional static observations. Daily, paused daily and webhook are distinct. Accepted dispatch does not mean completed work; a paused schedule has no next scheduled dispatch. A webhook has no Run now. Existing webhook filtering, dedupe and dispatch logging are retained conceptually without enabling an endpoint, modifying an agent, changing dispatch, or claiming new webhook authority.
